name: BL-042 criteria, addendum 2: detector fixes from the gallery check, the detector freeze, and a score learned from past outcomes
adds_to: bl042_criteria.json and addendum 1 - unchanged except where this file says
rule: Committed before any forward return is computed (Phases 4-6 have not run). Never edited after results are seen: a change is a new file that names this one as superseded, with the reason.

gallery_check.labelled_by_owner: 159 of 165 (2026-10-07). Precision, correct / (correct + wrong), unsure left out:
gallery_check.owner_caveat: The owner asked that their judgement not be taken as final, and that looking like a textbook pattern matters less than whether it pays (2026-10-07).
gallery_check.second_review: Claude reviewed 56 charts (every Wrong/Unsure flag and tight range, every Wrong cup, 6 random Unsure cups, 5 random Correct per pattern) against the written rules. It agreed on tight ranges and most flags, and judged most cups doubtful.
consistent_findings: Cup and handle: every sampled cup had a 1-week handle (the gallery shows the first detected week). The owner noted 'only cup / handle still forming' 14 times.
Cup and handle: many 'cups' are bounces inside a downtrend or a range, with a left lip that is no real top.
Flag: some 'poles' are rebounds after a crash (s041, s043, s050, s124), not a run from strength.
Data: one flag's pole starts on a single bad low print (s075), a wick far below that bar's open and close.
gallery_check.kill_gate: No pattern is dropped. Given the owner's caveat, the gallery is used to find detector bugs, not to rule a pattern out; whether a pattern pays is left to Phases 4-6.

bad_bar_wick.plain: Added to the bad-bar rule: a bar whose low is more than 15% below the lower of its open and close, or whose high is more than 15% above the higher, is a bad print. Detectors refuse a window containing one.

tight_range.pivot: highest high of the tightest qualifying window
tight_range.changed: near_high added: the close within 25% of the 52-week high (a base near highs, not a pause in a slide)

flag.changed: near_high and uptrend added: the pole must lift the stock into an uptrend near its 52-week high, so a rebound after a crash is not a flag

cup_handle.pivots: causal zigzag on weekly closes, reversal 8%; a swing point exists only from the week that confirmed it
cup_handle.changed: handle min_weeks 1 -> 2; the left lip must be the highest high of the 26 weeks up to it (a real top); near_high added

learned_score.asked_by: owner, 2026-10-07: rank a setup both by how textbook it looks (addendum 1's quality) and by how such setups paid before
learned_score.plain: For a detection at week t: the average 13-week excess return (over non-pattern pool stocks in the same momentum decile, as in the event study) of EARLIER detections in the same cell whose 13 weeks had fully ended by t. A cell is pattern x state x quality third (cut points from the development detections). Nothing after t is used.
learned_score.too_few: score 0.5 (neutral) until the cell has min_past_cases finished cases

shape.name: learned_0.5
shape.how: blend at weight 0.5 with the learned score in place of the pattern score

learned_score.holdout: In Phase 6 the learned score keeps learning causally from development and earlier hold-out detections, exactly as a live system would.
